concepts.learning_objective: Explain how variations accumulate over generations and why sexual reproduction creates more diversity than asexual reproduction.
Explain how environmental selection of variants helps some individuals survive better.

topics.title: Inherited traits and Mendel's monohybrid cross

concepts.learning_objective: Identify inherited traits and their variants, such as free and attached earlobes, in human populations.
Describe Mendel's cross between tall and short pea plants and predict F1 and F2 results.
Distinguish dominant and recessive traits and use them to interpret inheritance data.

topics.title: Inheritance of two traits: independent inheritance

concepts.learning_objective: Work out the F1 and F2 progeny of a cross involving two pairs of contrasting traits.
Explain how new combinations of traits in the F2 generation show that traits are inherited independently.

topics.title: How traits are expressed: genes, proteins and chromosomes

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how a gene controls a trait by providing information for a protein such as an enzyme.
Explain how chromosomes and germ cells with a single gene set ensure equal contribution of both parents.
Describe the different ways in which sex is determined in different species.
Explain how the X and Y chromosomes determine the sex of a child in human beings.
